SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'rutinas',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(p.oid::regprocedure::text,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.prosecdef,p.proconfig,p.proacl::text,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('calcular_total_pedido','registrar_detalle_pedido','fn_set_subtotal','fn_validar_detalle_vigente','fn_recalcular_total_insert','fn_recalcular_total_update','fn_recalcular_total_delete','api_registrar_detalle_pedido','fn_autenticar','fn_resetear_password')),
 'relaciones',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind::text,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relacl::text) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','reportes')),
 'columnas',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(c.relname,a.attname,a.attacl::text) ORDER BY c.relname,a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('categoria','usuario','producto','pedido','detalle_pedido') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),
 'esquemas',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),n.nspacl::text) ORDER BY n.nspname) FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','reportes')),
 'membresias',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(roleid),pg_get_userbyid(member),admin_option,inherit_option,set_option) ORDER BY roleid,member) FROM pg_auth_members),
 'adp',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text,defaclobjtype::text,defaclacl::text) ORDER BY defaclrole,defaclnamespace,defaclobjtype) FROM pg_default_acl));

exit_semantics: 0 = archivo completado bajo ON_ERROR_STOP; proceso compartido, salida real en control_session_exit

command: SELECT rolname,rolcanlogin,rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'tst\_u5\_%' OR rolname IN ('app_web','admin_datos'); SELECT pg_get_userbyid(roleid),pg_get_userbyid(member),admin_option,inherit_option,set_option FROM pg_auth_members ORDER BY 1,2; SELECT 'categoria' AS tabla,count(*) FROM public.categoria UNION ALL SELECT 'usuario',count(*) FROM public.usuario UNION ALL SELECT 'producto',count(*) FROM public.producto UNION ALL SELECT 'pedido',count(*) FROM public.pedido UNION ALL SELECT 'detalle_pedido',count(*) FROM public.detalle_pedido;

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS propietario,has_table_privilege('rol_reportes',c.oid,'SELECT') AS select_efectivo FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND has_table_privilege('rol_reportes',c.oid,'SELECT') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('v','m') THEN pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) ELSE NULL END AS definicion,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('columna',a.attname,'tipo',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columnas FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND has_table_privilege('rol_reportes',c.oid,'SELECT') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;

SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('v','m') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND has_table_privilege('rol_reportes',c.oid,'SELECT') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;

SELECT c.id AS categoria_id,c.nombre AS categoria_nombre,date_trunc('month',p.fecha)::date AS mes,count(DISTINCT p.id) AS pedidos,count(DISTINCT p.usuario_id) AS usuarios_del_grupo,sum(d.cantidad) AS unidades,sum(d.subtotal) AS facturacion FROM public.categoria c JOIN public.producto pr ON pr.categoria_id=c.id JOIN public.detalle_pedido d ON d.producto_id=pr.id JOIN public.pedido p ON p.id=d.pedido_id WHERE NOT d.eliminado AND NOT p.eliminado GROUP BY c.id,c.nombre,date_trunc('month',p.fecha)::date ORDER BY categoria_id,mes;
